column1: # Measured `go test -race -short -p 1` duration per package, in seconds.
# Generated from the coverage-input test.log of a green CI run; used only to
# balance the shards of the `build-test` job. Unknown packages fall back to
# the median weight, so a stale table degrades balance, never coverage.
# Regenerate: gh run download <run> -n coverage-input-<sha> && awk ... test.log
